summary: Branch adds two Vercel config guards to vercel.json (root): `deploymentEnabled: false` for main/preview, and an `ignoreCommand` that prevents accidental leadflow-ai redeploys from the root project. These changes were never PR'd and are absent from main. PR #2021 (merged 2026-07-20) fixed the browser test symptom via a different approach (localhost detection in playwright-browser-setup.js), but did NOT ship the root-cause guard in vercel.json. The CLAUDE.md policy explicitly states 'No GitHub auto-deploy — all deployments are CLI-only', which this branch enforces. Changes are clean (vercel.json only, +7 lines), low-risk, and independently valuable.

The ignoreCommand logic is belt-and-suspenders (exits 0/skip for leadflow-ai project ID, exits 1/proceed otherwise), which is safe. The deploymentEnabled:false flag is a standard Vercel control.
